sections.heading: A model to test
sections.body: Build parallel sequences for the eastern empire, caliphates, and Latin West. Include both transfers of power and continuities in administration, religious authority, and exchange.

activities.prompt: “Charlemagne’s coronation recreated the Roman Empire exactly as it had been.” — is that an event claim or an interpretation?
activities.hint: A reused title or ceremony is evidence of a claim to continuity, not proof of institutional identity.
